name: orientation
title: Orientation: env, err, wrappers, and tools
fix_goal: Understand the p101 program shape before repairing issue-focused labs.
fix_steps: Read src/main.c to find p101_error_create, p101_env_create, p101_env_destroy, and p101_error_destroy.
Read the orientation scenario in src/playground.c.
Open the generated observe/report artifacts and connect resource events back to the wrapper calls.
lesson: Every p101 program starts with env/error setup, routes work through wrappers, and then uses the tools to make resource and call behavior visible.
